name: sandbox-factory
description: Core todo domain: the Todo type, title rules, filters, and counts.
author: feversoul

scripts.test: rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=90 --test-coverage-branches=90 --test-coverage-functions=90 --test-coverage-include="dist-test/src/**" --test-coverage-exclude="dist-test/test/**" --test dist-test/test/*.test.js > dist-test/coverage.txt; status=$?; cat dist-test/coverage.txt; [ $status -eq 0 ] && assert-all-covered dist-test/src dist-test/coverage.txt
